primary_endpoint.description: The location where the untrusted value reaches the dangerous operation (CR-LAB-0001 Addendum B tie-break: where it's used, never where it's set). Optional; a single-location case has no need of it beyond `url`.

related_endpoints.description: Other locations in this case's flow, beyond the primary one (SARIF relatedLocations shape). Empty/absent for a single-location case.

stack.description: Which stack profile this case's code belongs to (e.g. php_current, node_express, python_fastapi, php_laravel) -- the same meaning as fuzzlab.labgen.schema.Cell.stack_profile / CR-LAB-0001 §4's `stack_profile`. Inline per the settled research decision in docs/LAB_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md §4, not a separate analysis-only file. Optional and additive: absent on single-stack (pre-multi-stack) ground truth, and no scorer keys on it -- it is analysis metadata, chiefly the `stack` axis the fingerprint-independence gate (fuzzlab.labgen.fingerprint_gate) tests for independence from vuln_class/verdict.

flow_variant.description: How far the flow travels between source and sink (Juliet naming). Defaults to 'direct' when absent.
